args.content:
LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS (11 total):
- workday.hcm: HCM with compensation agents but NO API resources
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HCM - INCLUDES:
  * apiResource:EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1
  * agent:CompensationPolicyAutomationEngine:v1
  * agent:SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1 (WORKFORCE SKILLS INVENTORY & CAPABILITY ANALYSIS)
- sap.s4: ERP - INCLUDES:
  * agent:AssetLifecycleChangeOrchestrator:v1 (asset/equipment tracking, change orchestration, audit-ready)
  * agent:BOMComplianceAutomationAgent:v1
  * agent:ProcurementMatchingAgent:v1
  * agent:OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine:v1
  * MaterialReceiptInboundAPI (NO production queue/shift scheduling APIs)
- sap.crm: CRM - AGENTS ONLY (opportunity qualification, sales coordination, campaigns) - NO customer case management APIs/agents
- sap.ehs: Safety/health - AGENTS INCLUDING:
  * agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1 (ANALYZES SAFETY INCIDENTS, identifies root causes, trend analysis)
  * agent:SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator:v1 (validates materials against safety standards, automates BOM validation, chemical inventory compliance with regulatory standards)
  * agent:IncidentResponseCoordinator:v1 (emergency response, incident workflows)
  * agent:VendorComplianceAutomationOrchestrator:v1 (vendor safety certifications verification)
  * agent:VendorComplianceInvoiceAutomation:v1 (supplier invoice validation)
  * agent:ComplianceCampaignOrchestrator:v1 (compliance campaigns, safety interventions)
- sap.ariba: Procurement - AGENTS + APIs
- corp.itsm: IT service management AGENTS ONLY
- emarsys.cx: Customer experience/marketing AGENTS ONLY
- my.mes: Manufacturing - AGENTS ONLY
- siemens.plm: PLM AGENTS ONLY
- sap.odm: Entity type repository

KEY ACTIVITY MATCHES:
1. Chemical inventory documentation regulatory compliance: sap.ehs:agent:SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator:v1

args.reason: Automates validation of materials (including chemical inventory) against safety standards and regulatory requirements to keep documentation current and compliant.
